risk_note: RV2 migration (data model only; settlement-plan B2-04b, BR-FUND-18 / 19 / 22 / 23; S4, S15, decisions 36 and 40). Migration 0060_settlement-ledger-owned.sql: app.recon_diffs with the 04 columns plus nullable dedupe_key and resolution (S4), named constraints and indexes, unique (app_id, type, period, ref_id), partial unique on non-null dedupe_key per app and one month-end three-way mismatch per (app_id, month), type / source / status CHECKs from the contract enums including closed, handler FK to the app's admin users without cascade; app.asset_snapshots unique per (app_id, date) with a named (app_id, id) unique key; app.asset_snapshot_receivables child table for the per-platform union receivable (bigint fen, one row per snapshot and platform, platform limited to the contract list, composite FK (app_id, asset_snapshot_id) without cascade). Grants: couli_app SELECT / INSERT plus column-level UPDATE only on status / handler / closed_at / dedupe_key / resolution / updated_at and the snapshot comparability flag; amount columns are not updatable; couli_readonly SELECT. Two SET LOCAL timeouts; no DO block. db/schema.sql and db.gen.ts regenerated on the test machine. tools/ci/lint-migrations.test.ts lists the three new funds tables (additions only).
